messages:
Alex: Pinging folks — PR #12185 updates KV cache eviction defaults (max_prefix_cache_size: 1GB -> 512MB). Hits small dedicated instances with OOMs. Need runtime + infra + security approvals before we can merge this week. https://git.internal/r/12185 :link:

Nina: @Alex can you paste the perf matrix/latency numbers you ran? Also does this change affect cold-start latency for long-context models? :eyes:

Alex: perf numbers attached in CI artifact (see link). 95th token latency unaffected in our bench; memory pressure went down ~28% on t4-small runs. Cold-start bump ~+6ms on long sequences. https://ci.internal/builds/12185/artifacts

Jordan: @Alex curious about rollout plan — can we do a canary to 10% of Dedicated then 50%? Also any impact on autoscaler thresholds?

Alex: plan: canary 10% one region, monitor memory/evictions 1hr, then 50% next day. Autoscaler unaffected; I added metric evictions.kv_cache.rate to rollouts and alert if >0.5/s.

Tara: tagging @security — can you confirm there's no telemetry leakage from the new eviction logging? The change adds a stacktrace on OOMs.

Tara: Also need a quick review of the new logging format (should avoid including prompt text or user tokens).

Alex: Good call. Logging only emits metadata (model_id, shard_id, evicted_prefix_hash). No prompt text or keys. Snippet:
```
eviction_event: { model: "gpt-4r", shard: 3, evicted_prefix_hash: "ab12...", reason: "memory_pressure" }
```

Tara: thanks, that looks fine. Please ensure KMS-encrypted logs for that metric stream.

Nina: I can do functional review tomorrow AM, but need a quick test to validate no regressions on streaming. @Alex can you add an eval with 8k seq?

Alex: Added eval in the PR description and pinned it. CI green except flaky perf job. If all good, requesting approvals: Nina (runtime), Jordan (infra), Tara (security). Happy to wait for next merge window on Thursday.

ci-bot: Build #12185 passed all required checks. :white_check_mark:

Jordan: I'll take infra sign-off once canary metrics look stable. :thumbsup:

Nina: gave runtime approval in PR. :white_check_mark:

Tara: security approved, noted the KMS requirement and log redaction verified. :white_check_mark:

Alex: Thanks everyone — merging after Thursday merge window unless someone objects.
